classification.difficultyReason: Identify all five exposed surface components of a three-quarter cylinder including two radial cut rectangles before summing.

content.prompt: A sector of cheese is cut from a cylindrical block of cheese. Find the surface area of the remaining piece, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Explicit analytic remaining270degree cylindersector: topellipse(r6,b1.8) atheight3, missing front quadrant225..315, two visible radial cut faces and central vertical crease. answer.worked:
The remaining sector is 270°, or three quarters of the full cylinder. Include its two sector ends, remaining curved wall and both rectangular radial cut faces.
$$\begin{aligned}S&=2\left(\tfrac34\pi(6)^2\right)+\tfrac34(2\pi(6))(3)+2(6)(3)\\S&=54\pi+27\pi+36\\S&=(36+81\pi)\text{ cm}^2\approx290.47\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
